title: 第二十一章 灯下黑第二十二章 虎门销烟
content_zh:
：雷虎的死讯传到广州，是在何成局回来的第三天。
消息是蝎子带进春香楼的。干瘦的掮客坐在大堂角落里，用一碗凉茶润了润嗓子，说斧头帮总舵已经乱了套——副帮主和几个分舵主为了争帮主之位，在总舵里拍了桌子，鬼头七在佛山被人一锅端了分舵，至今不知道是谁下的手。广州城里其他几个帮派闻到血腥味，已经开始试探性地蚕食斧头帮的地盘。铁线帮抢了城西两家赌场，洪门的人趁夜砸了斧头帮在珠江边的私盐仓库，连一贯低调的潮州帮都派人在码头边上多占了两个泊位。
何成局听完，给蝎子续了一碗茶。
“雷虎一死，斧头帮不足为惧。但新帮主上来的第一件事，一定是拿春香楼立威。”何成局说这话的时候语气很平淡，像是在分析一笔跟自己无关的买卖，“谁砍了春香楼的招牌，谁在道上就有了面子。这个道理新帮主懂，我们也得懂。”
他从柜台下面取出龚文早已备好的银子，让蝎子拿去打点各方——知府衙门的刘师爷、南海县的几个书吏、水师码头上管巡查的两个百总，每一个关节都塞到了。蝎子把银子一份一份点清，用油纸包好揣进怀里，临走前压低声音问了一句：“二爷，鬼头七那事，是你干的？”
何成局端起茶杯喝了一口，没说是，也没说不是。蝎子看了他一眼，不再追问，推门走了。
安顿秦舒云的事，比何成局预想的要顺利得多。
他把秦舒云带回春香楼的当晚，余三娘只问了一句话：“住多久？”何成局说：“先住着。”余三娘点了点头，转身去后院收拾房间，从头到尾没有问这个姑娘是谁、从哪里来、跟何成局是什么关系。她的逻辑很简单：何成局是二当家，他说住就住。账上多一口人吃饭，月底她会把账目明细放在他桌上，这就够了。
但姑娘们没有这么容易打发。第二天一大早，唐玲就端着桂花糕跑去后院敲门，美其名曰“给新来的姐姐送点心”，实际上是想看看这个被二爷亲自带回来的女人长什么样。林函难得早起，打着哈欠跟过去看热闹。张颜站在走廊里抱着胳膊，不进去也不离开，保持着一个“我并没有在等八卦但如果有人要告诉我我也会听”的姿态。
秦舒云打开门的时候，面对的是三双不同程度好奇的眼睛。她穿着一件素净的蓝布衫，头发简单地挽在脑后，手里拿着那支旧毛笔——她正在默写父亲留下的碑文。唐玲把桂花糕往她手里一塞，歪着头打量了片刻，回头对张颜喊道：“是个美人！”张颜翻了个白眼，走了。
柳如烟来的时候没有带点心也没有带茶水。她抱着琴走进后院，在秦舒云对面的石凳上坐下，把琴横在膝上，弹了一首极短的曲子。曲子不长，但每一个音都弹得极稳，像是用琴声在跟对面的人打招呼。秦舒云听完之后沉默了一会儿，说：“这是《阳关三叠》的起手式，但第三句改了调。”柳如烟的手指在琴弦上轻轻停住，看着她。秦舒云又说：“改得很好。比原曲多了几分婉转，少了离别的悲切。”
柳如烟没有笑——她几乎从来不笑。但她坐下来，把琴往秦舒云的方向挪了半寸，开始弹第二首。
何成局从大堂窗户里远远看到这一幕，没有走过去。他知道秦舒云已经在春香楼找到了自己的位置——不是妾，不是丫鬟，而是一个能跟柳如烟聊琴曲的知音。这种关系比任何名分都更稳固。
但安稳的日子从来不会超过三天。
第四天傍晚，蝎子又来了。这次他没有坐，也没有喝茶，径直走到何成局面前压低声音说：“二爷，出事了。斧头帮新帮主选出来了——是雷虎的弟弟雷豹。他今晚在聚义楼摆了二十桌，请了广州城大小帮派的头面人物，放话要拿春香楼的人头血祭雷虎。”
何成局放下茶杯。
“什么时候动手？”
“不知道。但消息可靠——雷豹在酒席上当众说的：三天之内，春香楼的招牌就是斧头帮的新匾额。”
何成局的手指在桌面上轻轻敲着。雷豹这个人他听说过——雷虎的胞弟，今年三十出头，在斧头帮里外号“豹子头”。跟他哥不一样，雷豹性子暴烈，做事不计后果，雷虎活着的时候压着他没出过什么大事，现在没人压了，上来就要拿春香楼开刀。
“他手下有多少人？”

“雷虎留下的精锐还剩下七八十个。加上雷豹自己这些年积攒的死党，大概一百二十号人。”蝎子说到这里顿了顿，又补了一句，“还有一件事。潘启明在牢里绝食三天，要求见林则徐。林则徐答应见他。两人谈了一个时辰。之后林则徐发了一道手令——暂停查封行商私宅，改为重点追查已经登记但未缴清的鸦片。潘启明主动供出了一批藏在十三行货栈里的鸦片，换取从轻发落。”
何成局沉默了片刻。潘启明在牢里绝食求见林则徐，主动供出鸦片——这一手玩得很高明。他知道林则徐的目标不是行商本人而是鸦片，主动缴烟换轻判，总比被抄家砍头强。但他供出的是“一批藏在十三行货栈里的鸦片”，没有提佛山的矿洞。那批货是潘启明最后的底牌，他就算死也要攥在手里。
“潘启明什么时候放出来？”
“等林则徐验完那批烟，大概三五天。出来之后他不能再碰鸦片生意，但只要人还在广州，迟早会来找你。”
何成局点了点头。他站起身走到柜台前，对龚文说：“今晚春香楼提前打烊。把大门闩好，后院的门也用木头顶上。姑娘们全部回房，不点大灯。另外让刘二把后门柴房里的两桶桐油搬到走廊拐角备着，万一有人翻墙进来就泼油点火——不是真烧，火光亮起来就行，能拖一炷香是一炷香。”
龚文的脸色白了几分，但没有多问，放下算盘就去安排了。
何成局又转向余三娘：“三娘，今晚你带姑娘们在地窖里过夜。地窖入口在厨房灶台下面，斧头帮的人就算闯进来也不容易找到。里面有干粮和水，够撑三天。”
余三娘看了他一眼，没有说“你呢”，也没有说“小心”。她只说了一句：“地窖的气孔被厨房后面的柴堆挡住了，我让刘二去清一下。”
何成局最后回了趟小四合院。他让周巧儿三人收拾几件换洗衣裳跟他走，什么都没解释。周巧儿看了他的表情，什么都没问，转身去拿包袱。赵麦穗抱起她的识字课本和旧字帖，沈小荷把没剥完的花生米倒进小布袋里，三个人不到一盏茶的工夫就收拾好了。
何成局把她们带到春香楼后院，安排在秦舒云隔壁的房间。秦舒云靠在门口，手里还拿着那支旧毛笔，看到周巧儿三人被何成局领进来，安静地退后一步让开了路。何成局对她说：“今晚地窖里过夜。”秦舒云点了点头，没有问为什么。
天彻底黑透的时候，柳花巷安静得反常。
平时这个时辰正是春香楼最热闹的时候——丝竹声、划拳声、姑娘们的笑声和客人的吆喝声混在一起，能把整条巷子吵翻天。但今晚大门紧锁，灯笼全灭，二楼三楼的窗户都拉上了厚帘子，从外面看就像一座空楼。
何成局独自坐在大堂中央。他把平时喝茶的方桌搬到正对大门的位置，桌上放着一壶茶、两个茶杯、一盏油灯。笑面虎短刀横放在茶杯旁边，刀鞘上那张歪歪扭扭的笑脸在昏黄的灯光里显得有些瘆人。他给自己倒了一杯茶，慢慢喝了一口。
亥时三刻，巷子里响起了脚步声。
不是一两个人的脚步，是一群人的脚步——密集、整齐、带着铁器碰撞的细微声响。何成局听声辨位，至少有四五十号人，已经把春香楼的正门和后巷全部围住了。
他端着茶杯，没有动。
大门被一脚踹开。门外是黑压压的人头，火把的光芒照亮了柳花巷的青石板，也照亮了为首那个壮汉的脸。雷豹——比雷虎年轻几岁，但身形更加魁梧，满脸横肉，左眼角有一道旧刀疤，手里提着一把比寻常斧头大了一倍的宽刃大斧。他看到大堂里只有何成局一个人坐在灯下喝茶，愣了一下，然后咧嘴笑了。
“何成局？你倒是有种，不跑。”
“跑什么。”何成局放下茶杯，朝雷豹举了举茶壶，“豹爷，喝茶吗？新到的茉莉花，还热着。”
雷豹大步跨进门槛，身后跟着二十几个手持利斧的帮众，呼啦啦涌进大堂，把何成局围在中间。火把的光照得何成局脸上的笑容忽明忽暗，但他端着茶杯的手纹丝不动。

“你杀了我哥。”雷豹把大斧往地上一顿，青砖应声碎裂。
“你哥派人砍伤了我的人。”何成局端起茶杯又喝了一口，“一只手，缝了十二针。你哥的命抵我的人的十二针，这笔账我觉得公平。”
雷豹的眼睛里几乎要喷出火来。他提起大斧指着何成局的脸：“今晚我就拿你的人头祭我哥！”
何成局把茶杯放下，站起来。他的动作很慢，慢到周围二十几个刀斧手都觉得这个人是不是被吓傻了。但何成局站起来之后做的事让所有人都愣了一下——他拿起桌上的笑面虎短刀，但没有拔刀出鞘，而是把整把刀放在茶壶旁边，然后摊开双手，示意自己手里什么都没有。
content_en:
: The news of Lei Hu's death reached Guangzhou on the third day after He Chengju returned.
The news was brought into Chunxiang Tower by Scorpion. The skinny broker sat in the corner of the lobby, moistened his throat with a bowl of herbal tea, and said that the general helmsman of the Ax Gang was in chaos. The deputy gang leader and several sub-rulers were fighting for the position of gang leader. Several other gangs in Guangzhou city smelled blood and have begun to tentatively encroach on the Ax Gang's territory. The Iron Line Gang robbed two casinos in the west of the city. People from Hongmen smashed the Ax Gang's private salt warehouse on the Pearl River at night. Even the always low-key Chaozhou Gang sent people to occupy two more berths beside the pier.
After hearing this, He Chengju refilled a bowl of tea for Xie Zi.
"Once Lei Hu dies, the Ax Gang will have nothing to fear. But the first thing the new gang leader will do is to use Chunxiang Tower to establish his authority." He Chengju said this in a very calm tone, as if he was analyzing a deal that had nothing to do with him. "Whoever cuts down the Chunxiang Tower sign will gain face in the public eye. The new gang leader understands this, and we must understand it too."
He took out the money that Gong Wen had already prepared from under the counter and asked Xie Zi to use it to deal with various parties - Mr. Liu from the prefect's Yamen, several clerks from Nanhai County, and the two chief inspectors in charge of inspections at the Navy dock. Every joint was stuffed. Xie Zi counted the money one by one, wrapped it in oil paper and put it in his arms. Before leaving, he asked in a low voice: "Second Master, was it you who did what happened to Guitou Qi?"
He Chengju picked up the tea cup and took a sip, without saying yes or no. Scorpion glanced at him, opened the door and left without asking any more questions.
The matter of settling Qin Shuyun went much smoother than He Chengju expected.
The night he brought Qin Shuyun back to Chunxiang House, Yu Sanniang only asked: "How long will you stay?" He Chengju said: "Live first." Yu Sanniang nodded, turned to the backyard to clean up the room, and never asked who this girl was, where she came from, or what her relationship was with He Chengju. Her logic is simple: He Chengju is the second in charge, so he can live wherever he says. If there is one more person to eat on the account, she will put the account details on his table at the end of the month, and that is enough.
But the girls were not so easily dismissed. Early the next morning, Tang Ling ran to the backyard with her sweet-scented osmanthus cake and knocked on the door, euphemistically calling it "giving snacks to the new sister". In fact, she wanted to see what the woman brought back by the second master personally looked like. Lin Han rarely got up early, yawned and followed him to watch the fun. Zhang Yan stood in the corridor with her arms folded, neither entering nor leaving, maintaining a posture of "I'm not waiting for gossip, but if someone wants to tell me, I will listen."
When Qin Shuyun opened the door, he was faced with three pairs of eyes with varying degrees of curiosity. She was wearing a plain blue shirt, her hair was simply pulled back, and she was holding the old writing brush in her hand - she was silently writing the inscription left by her father. Tang Ling pushed the sweet-scented osmanthus cake into her hand, tilted her head and looked at it for a moment, then turned around and shouted to Zhang Yan, "She is a beauty!" Zhang Yan rolled his eyes and left.
Liu Ruyan didn't bring snacks or tea when she came. She walked into the backyard with the piano in her arms, sat down on the stone bench opposite Qin Shuyun, put the piano across her knees, and played a very short piece of music. The piece is not long, but every note is played very steadily, as if the sound of the piano is used to greet the person opposite. Qin Shuyun was silent for a while after listening, and said: "This is the starting position of "Yangguan Three Pieces", but the third sentence has changed the key." Liu Ruyan's fingers stopped lightly on the strings and looked at her. Qin Shuyun added: "The change is very good. It is a bit more tactful than the original song, and less sad about parting."
Liu Ruyan didn't smile - she almost never smiled. But she sat down, moved the piano half an inch towards Qin Shuyun, and started playing the second piece.
He Chengju saw this scene from a distance from the lobby window and did not walk over. He knew that Qin Shuyun had found his place in Chunxiang Tower——Not a concubine, not a maid, but a bosom friend who can chat with Liu Ruyan about piano music. This relationship is stronger than any title.
But the days of peace never last longer than three days.
On the evening of the fourth day, the scorpion came again. This time he did not sit down or drink tea. He walked straight to He Chengjing and said in a low voice: "Second Master, something happened. The Ax Gang has elected a new gang leader - it is Lei Hu's younger brother Lei Bao. He has set up twenty tables at Juyi Building tonight, invited the leading figures from the big and small gangs in Guangzhou City, and promised to sacrifice the blood of Chunxiang Building's heads to Lei Hu."
He Chengju put down his tea cup.
"When will we do it?"
"I don't know. But the news is reliable - Lei Bao said it in public at the banquet: Within three days, the sign of Chunxiang House will be the new plaque of the Ax Gang."
He Chengju tapped his fingers lightly on the table. He has heard of Lei Bao - Lei Hu's younger brother, who is in his early thirties and is nicknamed "Leopard Head" in the Ax Gang. Unlike his brother, Lei Bao had a violent temper and did things regardless of the consequences. When Lei Hu was alive, he suppressed him without any major incident. Now that no one suppresses him anymore, Chunxianglou will be operated upon.
"How many men does he have?"
"There are still seventy or eighty elites left by Lei Hu. Including the buddies that Lei Bao has accumulated over the years, there are about one hundred and twenty people." Xie Zi paused here and added, "One more thing. Pan Qiming went on a hunger strike for three days in prison and asked to see Lin Zexu. Lin Zexu. Xu agreed to meet him. The two talked for an hour. After that, Lin Zexu issued a warrant to suspend the seizure of the merchants' private houses and focus on tracking down the opium that had been registered but not paid. Pan Qiming took the initiative to provide a batch of opium hidden in the Shisanhang warehouse in exchange for a lighter sentence. "
He Chengju was silent for a moment. Pan Qiming went on a hunger strike in prison to ask for an audience with Lin Zexu, and took the initiative to provide opium - a very clever move. He knew that Lin Zexu's target was not the businessman himself but the opium, so he took the initiative to hand over the cigarettes in exchange for a light sentence, which was better than having his house confiscated and beheaded. But what he confessed was "a batch of opium hidden in the Shisanhang Warehouse" and did not mention the mines in Foshan. That batch of goods was Pan Qiming's last trump card, and he would hold on to it even if he died.
"When will Pan Qiming be released?"
"It will take about three to five days for Lin Zexu to finish inspecting the batch of cigarettes. After he comes out, he can no longer touch the opium business, but as long as he is still in Guangzhou, he will come to you sooner or later."
He Chengju nodded. He stood up and walked to the counter and said to Gong Wen: "Chunxiang Building will close early tonight. Bolt the door and use a wooden top on the door to the backyard. The girls will all go back to the room without lighting the big lamps. In addition, let Liu Er move the two barrels of tung oil from the woodshed at the back door to the corner of the corridor for preparation. If someone climbs over the wall and comes in, pour oil and light a fire - not real burning, just light up the fire. If you can drag an incense stick, it is an incense stick."
Gong Wen's face turned a little pale, but he didn't ask any more questions, put down his abacus and went to make arrangements.
He Chengju turned to Yu Sanniang again: "Sanniang, you take the girls to spend the night in the cellar tonight. The entrance to the cellar is under the kitchen stove, and it is not easy for the Ax Gang to find it even if they break in. There is dry food and water inside, which is enough for three days."
Yu Sanniang glanced at him, but didn't say "where are you" or "be careful". She only said: "The air hole in the cellar is blocked by the firewood pile behind the kitchen. I asked Liu Er to clean it."
He Chengju finally went back to the small courtyard. He asked Zhou Qiaoer and the others to pack a few changes of clothes and follow him without explaining anything. Zhou Qiaoer looked at his expression, didn't ask anything, turned around to get the baggage. Zhao Maisui picked up her literacy textbook and old copybook, and Shen Xiaohe poured the unpeeled peanuts into a small cloth bag. The three of them packed it up in less than a cup of tea.
He Chengju took them to the backyard of Chunxiang Building and arranged them in the room next to Qin Shuyun. Qin Shuyun leaned against the door, still holding the old writing brush in his hand. When he saw Zhou Qiaoer and the others being led in by He Chengju, he quietly stepped back and got out of the way. He ChengThe police officer said to her: "Sleep in the cellar tonight." Qin Shuyun nodded without asking why.
When it was completely dark, Liuhua Lane was unusually quiet.
Usually this hour is the busiest time in Chunxiang Tower - the sound of strings and bamboos, the sound of punches, the laughter of girls and the shouts of guests can mix together, which can make the whole alley noisy. But tonight the door is locked, all the lanterns are out, and thick curtains are drawn on the windows on the second and third floors. From the outside, it looks like an empty building.
He Chengju sat alone in the middle of the lobby. He moved the square table where he usually drank tea to the position facing the door. There was a pot of tea, two teacups and an oil lamp on the table. The Smiling Tiger Sword was placed horizontally next to the tea cup, and the crooked smiling face on the scabbard looked a bit scary in the dim light. He poured himself a cup of tea and took a slow sip.
At three o'clock in the morning, footsteps sounded in the alley.
It was not the footsteps of one or two people, but the footsteps of a group of people - dense, neat, and with the subtle sound of the collision of iron tools. He Chengju listened to the sound and identified his position. There were at least forty or fifty people who had surrounded the main entrance and back alley of Chunxiang Building.
He held the tea cup and did not move.
The door was kicked open. Outside the door was a mass of black heads. The light of the torch illuminated the bluestone slabs of Liuhua Lane and also illuminated the face of the strong man at the head. Thunder Leopard - A few years younger than Thunder Tiger, but more burly, with a fleshy face, an old scar on the corner of his left eye, and holding a broad-bladed ax that is twice the size of an ordinary ax in his hand. He saw He Chengju alone in the lobby sitting under the lamp drinking tea. He was stunned for a moment, then grinned.
"What's the deal? You have the guts not to run away."
"Why are you running?" He Chengju put down the tea cup and raised the teapot towards Lei Bao, "Master Bao, do you want some tea? The newly arrived jasmine flowers are still hot."
Lei Bao strode across the threshold, followed by more than twenty gangsters holding sharp axes, who rushed into the lobby and surrounded He Chengju. The light from the torch made the smile on He Chengju's face flicker, but his hand holding the tea cup remained motionless.
"You killed my brother." Lei Bao slammed the ax on the ground, and the bricks shattered.
"Your brother sent someone to chop up one of my men." He Chengju picked up the tea cup and took another sip. "One hand received twelve stitches. Your brother's life is worth the twelve stitches of my man. I think this account is fair."
Thunder Leopard's eyes almost burst out with fire. He raised the ax and pointed it at He Chengju's face: "I will sacrifice your head to my brother tonight!"
He Chengju put down his tea cup and stood up. His movements were so slow that the twenty or so swordsmen around him felt that this man was frightened. But what He Chengju did after he stood up stunned everyone - he picked up the Smiling Tiger Dagger on the table, but did not unsheath it. Instead, he placed the entire knife next to the teapot, then spread his hands to indicate that he had nothing in his hands.
